name: Charon
bio: Archetype: Dynamo, AoE DPT, Reaping. ⌽ Deploys [Pulsing Field] at turn start if it isn't already active. Injects [Dynamo] into [Pulsing Field] to upgrade it at turn end. ⌽ When [Pulsing Field] levels up, consumes extra [Dynamo] to skip Lv. 2 and go directly to Lv. 3. When this happens, the next Ultimates cast by self and the ally in front cost no AP. ⌽ Skills debuff enemies and buff allies, granting additional DMG bonus, Crit Rate and crit conversion. Enemies with his debuff take Genesis DMG when they're at low HP. ⌽ Gains extra Moxie for each Spirit/Intellect ally when entering battle. ⌽ Unit death, skill use, overflowing [Dynamo] and ally Moxie grant Charon [Shock Wave], which he consumes to attack all enemies when under Ultimate channel. Each attack increases the duration of the buffs and debuffs he inflicted, and generates Moxie and [Dynamo] for himself.
